shadows.name: surface-low
shadows.purpose: Separates cards from the pale canvas without a heavy outline.

motion.name: onboarding-loop
motion.purpose: Keeps the first-run health illustrations gently active.

narrative.overview: MediSeen uses familiar Material structure with a bright, reassuring health identity. Large navy headings and generous spacing reduce cognitive load; white elevated surfaces organize tasks without making the app feel institutional.

rules.name: Saturation Budget
rules.body: Use strong violet or pink for a single primary action or selected state in each region.

rules.name: Two-Step Scan
rules.body: Every screen exposes an obvious bold heading and a clearly quieter body level before controls.

dos: Keep primary actions visible on task-entry screens.
Preserve 48dp touch targets and multilingual labels.
donts: Do not introduce competing primary actions.
Do not replace native Android navigation or permission behavior with web-like controls.
